dict.string: JARVIS uses your microphone for local dictation and optional two-clap activation. Audio stays on this Mac.
JARVIS shows your words live in the command bar using on-device speech recognition. Commands are verified locally with Whisper after you pause.
JARVIS controls apps only in response to your commands: Chrome tabs, Apple Notes and Messages.
JARVIS resolves the contact you name when you ask to send an iMessage.
